headline:
Strong momentum,
not yet profitable
chart_note: 10-day range: $27.85 - $29.62. Pulled back to $27.88 after touching a 10-day high.
why_today: Down about 2% today after a very strong month - still trading well above its 50-day and 200-day averages.
pro_1: Revenue growing over 43% year over year, among the fastest in its software peer group
pro_2: Up roughly 27% in the past month, comfortably above both its 50-day and 200-day averages
con_1: Not yet GAAP-profitable - earnings actually worsened about 51% year over year
con_2: Small-cap and volatile; near its 52-week high after a fast rally leaves less room for error
